# Feature: Brief Section Consolidation

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-WI-002
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_web_intelligence.md`

Deterministic (`--no-llm`) Briefs stop forcing four kind-specific sections (Numbers & figures / Key facts / People & organizations / Notable quotes — the last two frequently degrade to gibberish because the local NER has no PERSON/ORG types). The Brief becomes three honest tiers: **Key Findings** (unchanged), **Key facts** (facts + numbers, keeping the key-figures table), and **Additional findings** (entities, quotes, and any future kinds). Every existing threshold (≥2 groups per section, detail caps) carries over, so thin sections still disappear instead of padding.

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

No persisted data model changes. The Brief protocol schema is untouched — `Section.heading` is already free text; only the deterministic composer's grouping changes. Internally, `SECTION_HEADINGS` (kind → heading pairs) becomes a kind-_set_ table:

```ts
/** Consolidated section plan: emission order, heading, and member claim kinds. */
const SECTION_PLAN = [
  { heading: 'Key facts', kinds: new Set(['fact', 'number']) },
  { heading: 'Additional findings', kinds: new Set(['entity', 'quote']) },
] as const;
```

## 3. Files

- `packages/core/src/synthesis/deterministic.ts` — replace `SECTION_HEADINGS` (lines ~71–76) with `SECTION_PLAN`; rework `composeSections` to filter the pool by kind _set_ and to build the key-figures table from the number-kind subset _inside_ `Key facts`.
- `packages/core/tests/synthesis/` (existing deterministic/section specs) — update expectations to the two-section layout.
- `e2e/golden-briefs/expected/*.brief.json` — regenerated once via `pnpm golden:update`.
- `docs/` — any user-facing doc that names the old section headings.

## 4. Dependencies

- None. (FEAT-WI-003 builds on this layout — land this first so the NLP quick wins are evaluated against the new sections and goldens churn once, not twice.)
